environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode). Security group allows inbound 443/80 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection layer. Flask app runs directly via gunicorn on port 8080. SQLite database on local EBS volume. Authentication is via static API keys provisioned during user creation.

config.load_balancer: AWS Classic ELB, TCP mode passthrough on port 443
config.database: SQLite 3.39 on local EBS gp3 volume
